limits: Labels identify the photographed subject, not every plant in the frame. A different labelled subject supports a wrong-subject target suggestion, never scene-level absence.

Publisher learn_tag train photos are excluded. The organisers used val for model selection; test is the cleanest estimate of PlantCLEF generalization. DINOv2 pretraining image overlap and BioCLIP 2 TreeOfLife-200M overlap are not audited.
Clematis paniculata, Austroderia, Leptospermum, Kunzea, Clematis forsteri and Clematis foetida are absent. Cytisus scoparius is a lookalike, not a watchlist target.

Only 20 val/test photos per target species. Wilson intervals use photos as units; photos may share observations and are not guaranteed independent. This southwestern European single-plant cohort does not estimate New Zealand scene performance or prevalence.
Publisher val/test covers fewer taxa than the classifier's 7,806 classes; configuration records observed binomial coverage of the complete pinned metadata, before sampling.
Organ tags are reported descriptively for target photos, not as reliable botanical strata.

Non-targets include every available same-genus/same-family subject and a salted-hash sample of 5,000 other plants. The pooled rate depends on this deliberately enriched cohort. BioCLIP rankings cover only the frozen watchlist/comparison prompt vocabulary.
Per-photo licences and authors are retained in metadata and image receipts; licences vary. Images stay outside Git. The converted PlantCLEF checkpoint is CC BY-NC 4.0.

The publisher provides no per-image checksums. First HTTPS downloads establish local SHA-256 receipts; every replay verifies those bytes. The metadata and model assets are verified against pinned SHA-256 checksums even on an entirely cached run.
